headline: DeepSeek still owns a third of the board, but its share slipped 3.8 points today
summary: DeepSeek remains the heavyweight at 33.8% of tokens, though it gave back 3.8 points since yesterday. MiniMax's minimax-m3.1-flash is on day 3 of its all-time token-share record at 2.6%.
highlights: DeepSeek's provider share is 33.8%, down 3.8 points on the day: still the heavyweight, just a little less heavy.
Zhipu AI and DeepSeek together hold 46.3% of tokens; add OpenAI and the top three reach 55.7%.
Tencent's provider share jumped 1.6 points to 7.3%, the biggest one-day gain among the leaders.
minimax-m3.1-flash climbed 6 spots to rank 10 and is on day 3 of its all-time token-share record at 2.6%.
Three OpenAI models debuted in the lower reaches of the board: gpt-6-sol at 45, gpt-oss-120b at 50, and gpt-6-astra at 51.
